metadata.name: Exchange rate providers
metadata.description: Keeps each organization's exchange rates up to date from pluggable providers (BCV for Venezuela, the European Central Bank, or typed by hand), writes them append-only to fx_rates and prefills the POS. If a provider is down the last rate stays and is flagged as old; a manual rate is never shadowed by an automatic one.
metadata.author: Asteby
features: Pluggable providers: BCV (official and parallel USD→VES), ECB (EUR base, with exact cross rates) and manual; Banxico documented as a stub until its token connector exists
Per-organization choice of provider, default rate kind and refresh frequency; 'auto' suggests one from the currencies the organization enabled
Append-only and idempotent: re-running never duplicates a rate, and a manual rate newer than the provider's is never shadowed
Resilient: when a provider fails the last rate is kept, the failure is recorded and the rate is flagged old with its age
Prefills the POS: fx.rate.current answers value, kind, source, date and age; fx.rate.refresh makes sure the rate is today's when the till opens
Bridges into the POS's local rate table while the POS still reads it, one row per day, never overwriting a day that already has a rate

es.name: Proveedores de tasa de cambio
es.description: Mantiene al día las tasas de cambio de cada organización desde proveedores enchufables (BCV para Venezuela, el Banco Central Europeo o escritas a mano), las guarda solo-de-añadir en fx_rates y prellena el POS. Si un proveedor falla se conserva la última tasa y se marca como vieja; una tasa manual nunca queda tapada por una automática.
features: Proveedores enchufables: BCV (oficial y paralelo USD→VES), BCE (base EUR, con cruces exactos) y manual; Banxico queda documentado como stub hasta que exista su conector con token
Por organización: proveedor, tipo de tasa por defecto y frecuencia; 'auto' sugiere uno según las monedas habilitadas
Solo-de-añadir e idempotente: repetir la corrida nunca duplica una tasa, y una tasa manual más reciente que la del proveedor nunca se tapa
Tolerante a fallos: si el proveedor cae se conserva la última tasa, se registra el fallo y se marca como vieja con su antigüedad
Prellena el POS: fx.rate.current responde valor, tipo, fuente, fecha y antigüedad; fx.rate.refresh asegura que sea la de hoy al abrir la caja
Puente al POS: mientras el POS lea su tabla local de tasas, agrega una fila por día sin pisar un día que ya tenga tasa

capabilities.reason: Read the latest rates to skip duplicates, to see whether a manual rate outranks the provider's and to answer fx.rate.current.
Append a provider rate (rates are never updated or deleted).
Know the organization's base currency and the foreign currencies it enabled, to ask the provider only for what it needs.
Find the POS currency codes (e.g. Bs) that correspond to a rate's quote currency.
Avoid a second row for a day that already has a POS rate.
Add the day's rate to the POS table it reads today (compatibility bridge, one row per day).
Read when each provider last succeeded or failed.
Record each refresh (provider, time, rates written, last error).
Read the BCV official and parallel USD→VES rates (GET, public, no credentials).
Read the European Central Bank daily reference rates (GET, public XML, no credentials).
